Hello, Ramesh ji? Main Sunita bol rahi h.text: Sunita says this call is about painting.
Hello, Ramesh ji? Main Sunita bol rahi h.quote: Hello, Ramesh ji? Main Sunita bol rahi hoon. Sharma ji ne aapka number diya tha, painting ke liye.

Haan ji madam, namaste. Sharma ji ne bat.text: Ramesh says hello and asks what work is needed.
Haan ji madam, namaste. Sharma ji ne bat.quote: Haan ji madam, namaste. Sharma ji ne bataya tha. Boliye, kya kaam hai?

Mera 2BHK flat hai, Indirapuram mein. Po.text: Sunita says her 2BHK flat in Indirapuram is to be painted completely, including both bedrooms, the hall, the kitchen, and the balcony grill.
Mera 2BHK flat hai, Indirapuram mein. Po.value: paint a 2BHK flat in Indirapuram, including both bedrooms, hall, kitchen, and balcony grill
Mera 2BHK flat hai, Indirapuram mein. Po.quote: Mera 2BHK flat hai, Indirapuram mein. Poora flat paint karwana hai - dono bedroom, hall, kitchen, aur balcony ki grill bhi.

Theek hai ji. Ceiling bhi karni hai ya s.text: Ramesh asks whether the ceiling should also be painted or only the walls.
Theek hai ji. Ceiling bhi karni hai ya s.quote: Theek hai ji. Ceiling bhi karni hai ya sirf walls?

Ceiling bhi. Aur ek bedroom mein thodi s.text: Sunita says the work also includes the ceiling and putty in one bedroom with some seepage.
Ceiling bhi. Aur ek bedroom mein thodi s.quote: Ceiling bhi. Aur ek bedroom mein thodi seelan hai, wahan putty bhi lagegi.

Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe peh.text: Ramesh says the seepage wall will get putty and primer first, then two coats, as part of the painting job.
Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe peh.quote: Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe pehle putty aur primer, phir do coat.

Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe peh.text: Ramesh asks whether normal emulsion or premium paint should be used.
Ho jayega madam. Seelan wali wall pe peh.quote: Paint kaunsa lagwana hai, normal emulsion ya premium wala?

Zyada mehenga nahi chahiye, normal emuls.text: Sunita says normal emulsion is fine for the painting.
Zyada mehenga nahi chahiye, normal emuls.quote: Zyada mehenga nahi chahiye, normal emulsion theek hai. Material aap laoge ya main mangwaun?

Zyada mehenga nahi chahiye, normal emuls.text: Sunita asks whether Ramesh will bring the material or whether she should arrange it.
Zyada mehenga nahi chahiye, normal emuls.quote: Zyada mehenga nahi chahiye, normal emulsion theek hai. Material aap laoge ya main mangwaun?

Material main le aaunga ji, aapko tensio.text: Ramesh says he will bring the material himself.
Material main le aaunga ji, aapko tensio.quote: Material main le aaunga ji, aapko tension nahi leni.

Material main le aaunga ji, aapko tensio.text: Ramesh says he will quote the labour and material together.
Material main le aaunga ji, aapko tensio.quote: Labour aur material mila ke bata deta hoon.

Haan to batao, total kitna lagega?.text: Sunita asks what the total cost will be.
Haan to batao, total kitna lagega?.quote: Haan to batao, total kitna lagega?

Dekhiye madam, 2BHK hai, putty ka kaam b.text: Ramesh says the total for labour and material together will be 28,000 rupees.
Dekhiye madam, 2BHK hai, putty ka kaam b.quote: Dekhiye madam, 2BHK hai, putty ka kaam bhi hai... labour material sab mila ke 28 hazaar lagega.

Arre 28 to bahut zyada hai. Pichhli baar.text: Sunita says 28 is very much too high and says the whole house was done for 20,000 last time.
Arre 28 to bahut zyada hai. Pichhli baar.quote: Arre 28 to bahut zyada hai. Pichhli baar 20 mein poora ghar hua tha.

Madam ab paint ka rate badh gaya hai. Ch.text: Ramesh says the total price is 25,000 rupees.
Madam ab paint ka rate badh gaya hai. Ch.quote: Madam ab paint ka rate badh gaya hai. Chaliye aapke liye 25 kar deta hoon, isse kam nahi hoga.

24 final karo, aur kaam achha hona chahi.text: Sunita offers 24,000 rupees as the final total for the job.
24 final karo, aur kaam achha hona chahi.quote: 24 final karo, aur kaam achha hona chahiye.

24 final karo, aur kaam achha hona chahi.text: Sunita says the work should be good.
24 final karo, aur kaam achha hona chahi.quote: 24 final karo, aur kaam achha hona chahiye.

Theek hai ji, 24 hazaar final. Labour, m.text: Worker Ramesh accepts 24,000 rupees as final.
Theek hai ji, 24 hazaar final. Labour, m.quote: Theek hai ji, 24 hazaar final. Labour, material, putty, sab ismein.

Theek hai ji, 24 hazaar final. Labour, m.text: Worker Ramesh says the 24,000 rupees includes labour, material, and putty.
Theek hai ji, 24 hazaar final. Labour, m.quote: Theek hai ji, 24 hazaar final. Labour, material, putty, sab ismein.

Done. Aur advance kitna chahiye aapko?.text: Sunita accepts the 24,000 rupee total proposed just before.
Done. Aur advance kitna chahiye aapko?.quote: Done. Aur advance kitna chahiye aapko?

Material lana padega na madam, to 8 haza.text: Ramesh asks for 8,000 rupees advance before starting the work.
Material lana padega na madam, to 8 haza.quote: Material lana padega na madam, to 8 hazaar advance de dijiye, kaam shuru karne se pehle.

8 hazaar... theek hai, jis din kaam shur.text: Sunita says 8,000 rupees will be paid by GPay the morning the work starts.
8 hazaar... theek hai, jis din kaam shur.quote: 8 hazaar... theek hai, jis din kaam shuru karoge us din subah GPay kar dungi.

Ji bilkul, chalega..text: The worker says 8,000 rupees is fine as the advance.

Achha ye batao, shuru kab karoge? Agle h.text: Sunita asks when the work will start and mentions guests coming next week.
Achha ye batao, shuru kab karoge? Agle h.quote: Achha ye batao, shuru kab karoge? Agle hafte mere ghar mehmaan aa rahe hain.

Madam is Monday se shuru kar deta hoon..text: Ramesh says he will start the work this Monday.
Madam is Monday se shuru kar deta hoon..quote: Madam is Monday se shuru kar deta hoon.

Madam is Monday se shuru kar deta hoon..text: Ramesh says he will also bring two more workers with him.
Madam is Monday se shuru kar deta hoon..quote: Do ladke aur lagaunga saath mein.

Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru,.text: Worker Ramesh says the work will start Monday and finish Friday evening.
Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru,.quote: Paanch din ka kaam hai ji. Monday shuru, Friday shaam tak poora finish.

Pakka Friday? Saturday ko mehmaan aa jay.text: Sunita says the work finish is Friday, and not later than that.
Pakka Friday? Saturday ko mehmaan aa jay.quote: Pakka Friday? Saturday ko mehmaan aa jayenge, uske baad nahi chalega.

Pakka madam, Friday shaam tak. Aap befik.text: Ramesh accepts the finish as Friday evening.
Pakka madam, Friday shaam tak. Aap befik.quote: Pakka madam, Friday shaam tak. Aap befikar rahiye.

Aur agar Friday tak nahi hua to? Pichhli.text: Sunita asks what happens if the work is not finished by Friday.
Aur agar Friday tak nahi hua to? Pichhli.quote: Aur agar Friday tak nahi hua to?

Aur agar Friday tak nahi hua to? Pichhli.text: Sunita says a previous contractor delayed a job by two weeks.
Aur agar Friday tak nahi hua to? Pichhli.quote: Pichhli baar ek contractor ne do hafte latka diya tha.

Aisa nahi hoga ji. Phir bhi agar late hu.text: Ramesh says if the work is late, 500 rupees should be cut for each day.
Aisa nahi hoga ji. Phir bhi agar late hu.quote: Aisa nahi hoga ji. Phir bhi agar late hua to har din ka 500 rupaye kaat lena aap.

Theek hai, 500 rupaye per day. Yaad rakh.text: Sunita accepts the 500 rupees per day deduction if the work is late.

Ji madam, zubaan di hai..text: Worker says he has given his word.

Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baj.text: Sunita says the worker should come Monday morning at 9 a.m.
Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baj.quote: Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baje aa jana, address main WhatsApp kar dungi.

Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baj.text: Sunita says she will send the address on WhatsApp.
Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baj.quote: Chalo theek hai phir. Monday subah 9 baje aa jana, address main WhatsApp kar dungi.

Ji madam, 9 baje pahunch jaunga. Dhanyav.text: The worker says he will arrive at 9 o'clock.

Theek hai Ramesh ji, to phir Monday ko m.text: Sunita says, "Theek hai Ramesh ji, to phir Monday ko milte hain."
Theek hai Ramesh ji, to phir Monday ko m.quote: Theek hai Ramesh ji, to phir Monday ko milte hain. Bye.
